def settle_braid_invoice(pricing: dict, tax: dict) -> dict:
    u_mat = pricing['u_matrix']
    v_mat = tax['v_matrix']
    yb = [[0, 1], [-1, 0]]
    u_yb_l1 = (
        abs(u_mat[0][0] - yb[0][0]) + abs(u_mat[0][1] - yb[0][1])
        + abs(u_mat[1][0] - yb[1][0]) + abs(u_mat[1][1] - yb[1][1])
    )
    v_yb_l1 = (
        abs(v_mat[0][0] - yb[0][0]) + abs(v_mat[0][1] - yb[0][1])
        + abs(v_mat[1][0] - yb[1][0]) + abs(v_mat[1][1] - yb[1][1])
    )
    holonomy_l1 = (
        abs(u_mat[0][0] - v_mat[0][0]) + abs(u_mat[0][1] - v_mat[0][1])
        + abs(u_mat[1][0] - v_mat[1][0]) + abs(u_mat[1][1] - v_mat[1][1])
    )
    surcharge = u_yb_l1 + v_yb_l1 + holonomy_l1
    payout = pricing['net_after_fee_cents'] - tax['tax_reserve_cents'] - surcharge
    return {
        'merchant_payout_cents': payout,
        'platform_fee_cents': pricing['platform_fee_cents'],
        'tax_reserve_cents': tax['tax_reserve_cents'],
        'u_yb_l1': u_yb_l1,
        'v_yb_l1': v_yb_l1,
        'holonomy_l1': holonomy_l1,
        'braid_surcharge_cents': surcharge,
    }
